2609.18248.title: Quanta: A Self-Contained Python Library for Hybrid Retrieval over Quantised Embeddings, Lexical Indexes, and Knowledge Graphs
2609.18248.paper_summary: An advanced retrieval-augmented generation pipeline is typically assembled from three or four independently operated systems: an approximate nearest-neighbour index, a full-text search engine, a graph database, and a relational document store. Each contributes its own deployment surface, configuration model, and failure modes, and the integration logic that binds them is written anew in every project. In this work, we present \textsc{Quanta}, an open-source Python library, which unifies dense vector search over 4-bit quantised embeddings, BM25 full-text retrieval, and knowledge-graph traversal behind a single retrieval API. Quanta makes two design commitments, which distinguish it from existing hybrid retrieval stacks. First, signals are combined by \emph{weighted reciprocal rank fusion} rather than by normalising heterogeneous scores onto a shared range, which we argue is ill-posed because such normalisations are query-dependent. Second, the graph is a \emph{candidate expander and not a relevance scorer}: traversal widens the candidate pool, and the newly admitted documents are re-scored by the dense indexes under an identifier allowlist, so structural adjacency determines what is considered while content evidence determines how it ranks.
2609.18248.paper_summary_zh: 一個先進的檢索增強生成管道通常由三到四個獨立運作的系統組成：一個近似最近鄰索引、一個全文搜索引擎、一個圖形資料庫和一個關聯文件存儲。每個系統都有其自己的部署表面、配置模型和故障模式，而將它們綁定在一起的整合邏輯在每個項目中都是全新編寫的。在這項工作中，我們介紹了 \textsc{Quanta}，一個開源的 Python 庫，該庫統一了 4 位量化嵌入的密集向量搜索、BM25 全文檢索和知識圖譜遍歷，並通過一個單一的檢索 API 提供服務。Quanta 做出了兩個設計承諾，使其與現有的混合檢索堆疊區別開來。首先，信號是通過 \emph{加權倒數排名融合} 組合的，而不是通過將異質分數標準化到共享範圍，因為我們認為這樣的標準化是錯誤的，因為這些標準化依賴於查詢。其次，圖形是一個 \emph{候選擴展器而不是相關性評分器}：遍歷擴大了候選池，而新接受的文件則根據識別者白名單下的密集索引重新評分，因此結構相鄰性決定了什麼被考慮，而內容證據則決定了其排名。
2609.18248.author: Ioannis E. Livieris et.al.
